content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius regional district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the applicant sought to dissolve the marriage due to the defendants fault and requested the court to assign a vehicle acquired during the marriage to the applicant the court granted the applicants requests for dissolution of the marriage determination of childs residence child maintenance and award of the vehicle the court also ordered the defendant to pay the applicants legal costs the court ruled that the applicant can keep her married name and the defendant must allow it the minor child will reside with the mother the defendant must give the applicant her personal property an audi a3 without compensation the defendant is also responsible for paying various costs including stamp duty and the costs of serving procedural documents
